hypothesis: Falling US initial unemployment claims relative to the corresponding52-week-earlier four-week period indicate improving global demand/risk appetite: long Brent and Russian equity index, short USDRUB. Rising claims reverse the whole basket. This is an unproved economic inference, not a law; Fed policy and Russian-specific shocks can dominate.
independence: New US labor-separation information, not price technicals, Russian business/household surveys, STLFSI risk-governor tuning, oil supply counts or an old parent mixture. No market feature, model fit, lag search or outcome-chosen sign.
